storage_desc: Carpetas que GodotHub comprueba al inicio. Destaca una carpeta para usarla tambien como ubicacion predeterminada para nuevos Proyectos/Descargas.
behavior_projects_desc: Aqui es donde como tus Proyectos seran organizado en GodotHub.
file_watchers_desc: Detecte automaticamente cambios en sus carpetas de escaneo y mantenga actualizados los Proyectos, Versiones y Plantillas sin hacer clic en Sincronizar.
last_opened_desc: Muestra la fecha y hora en que un proyecto se abrio por ultima vez en las Tarjetas de Proyecto. Se oculta por completo en los proyectos que nunca se han abierto
appearance_desc: Los cambios se aplican de inmediato en toda la aplicacion.
github_token_title: Token de la API de Github
github_token_desc: Opcionalmente establece un token de Acceso Personal de GitHub para aumentar el limite de solicitudes de la API de 60 a 5000 por hora.
titlebar_buttons: Botones de la barra de Titulo
titlebar_buttons_desc: Muestra o Oculta los botones de "Soporte" y "Dar una estrella en GitHub" en la barra de Titulo.
setup_wizard_again: Ejecuta nuevamente el asistente de configuracion.
reset_settings_desc: Restablece todo sobre esta pagina; Carpeta de Descargas; Carpetas de Escaneo; Apariencias y Comportamientos regresando por defecto. Carpetas de Escaneo y Descargas se mantendran; Solo se restablecen los controles deslizantes, los controles deslizantes y las selecciones de color.
delete_app_data_desc: Esto eleminara permanente todos los Espacios de Trabajo, Proyectos, Categorias, Versiones Instaladas, Y Configuraciones de GodotHub guardado, y reiniciar todo hasta la pantalla de "Primera vez", Tus carpetas de los proyectos actuales y descargas de Godot se mantendran intacto en tu disco
delete_data_desc: Permanently wipes every workspace, project, category, installed-version record, and setting GodotHub has stored. You will be restarted at first-time setup. Your actual project folders and Godot installs on disk are not touched, unless they live in the default download folder.
reset_all_desc: Esto restablecera todas las configuraciones de esta pagina, Carpetas de Descargas, Carpetas de Escaneos, Apariencias y Comportamientos, de regreso a por defecto, Esto no se puede deshacer
delete_all_title: Eleminar Permanente Datos de la Aplicacion?
delete_all_desc: Esto eleminara permanente todos los Espacios de Trabajo, Proyectos, Categorias, Versiones Instaladas, Y Configuraciones de GodotHub guardado, y reiniciar todo hasta la pantalla de "Primera vez", Tus carpetas de los proyectos actuales y descargas de Godot se mantendran intacto en tu disco, No se puede deshacer
empty_hint_projects: Carpetas sin ser Añadidos, no se escaneara nada al inicio, y nuevos proyectos estaran preguntando en donde guardar cada cierto tiempo.
empty_hint_versions: Carpetas sin ser Añadidos, no se escaneara nada al inicio, y las nuevas descargas se alamacenara en la carpeta AppData.
git_init_new_projects_desc: Tick the Git option by default in the New Project dialog. It adds a Godot .gitignore, a .gitattributes, and an initial commit on main.
naming_convention_desc: How the project folder is named when you create a new project. The project name always keeps the spaces you typed; only the folder name is transformed.
theme_preset_desc: Pick a full color theme. A preset controls every color in the app; choose Custom to use your own accent and background.
scan_result: Found {{projects}} new project(s) and {{versions}} new version(s).
keybind_instruction: Click the button below, then press any key to rebind.
settings_subtitle: Storage locations, auto-scan folders, and appearance.
template_scan_desc: Any subfolders inside this directory will be imported as templates when you click 'Import from Directory' in the Templates view.
launch_console_desc: Launches Godot in your terminal emulator so engine output is visible.
launch_console_desc_windows: Shows engine output, print() calls and errors in a console window, using the console executable Godot ships alongside the editor. Only available for versions that include one.
close_on_open_desc: Quits GodotHub automatically as soon as a project is launched in Godot.
close_on_open_desc_mac: Hides GodotHub automatically as soon as a project is launched in Godot. It keeps running in the Dock.
minimize_tray_label: Minimize to system tray on closing app
minimize_tray_desc: Keeps GodotHub running in the system tray instead of quitting when you close the window. Use the tray icon to reopen or quit.
reopen_desc: Brings GodotHub back out of the system tray automatically once the Godot editor for that project is closed.
reopen_desc_mac: Brings GodotHub back automatically once the Godot editor for that project is closed.
no_folder_set: No folder set. You can still import manually or use 'Save as Template'.
categories_off_desc: Turns off categories entirely, no Categories button, no category filter, no Uncategorized bucket. Projects shows one plain list. Existing category assignments are kept and come back if you turn this on again.
workspaces_off_desc: Turns off workspaces entirely, no workspace switcher, no "add workspace" button. GodotHub behaves as if there were only the one currently-active workspace. Existing workspaces are kept and the switcher comes back if you turn this on again.
date_format_label: Date format (shown for any other day)
projects_desc: Scanned at startup for existing projects. The starred folder pre-fills the "Location" field in the New Project dialog.
godot_versions_desc: Scanned at startup for installed Godot executables. The starred folder is where new Godot versions are extracted when you install them.
scan_depth_desc: How many folders deep to look inside each scan folder above. Lower is faster and avoids picking up unrelated projects/versions buried in nested subfolders; higher digs further if yours are deeply nested.
download_concurrency_desc: How many Godot versions can download at the same time. Extra downloads wait in a queue and start automatically as slots free up.
tray_recent_desc: How many recently opened projects appear in the system tray context menu. Set between 1 and 10.
auto_scan_desc: Automatically scans your configured project and version folders for new additions every time GodotHub starts. You can still scan manually anytime from the Projects and Versions views.
tooltip_delay_desc: How long to wait before showing tooltips when hovering over buttons, icons, and sidebar items. Lower values feel more responsive; higher values reduce distraction.
watch_projects_desc: Automatically scans for new or removed projects whenever files change inside your configured project scan folders. New project folders are added to your library; removed ones are left in place but unregistered.
watch_versions_desc: Automatically scans for new or removed Godot executables whenever files change inside your configured version scan folders. New executables are added to your installed versions list.
watch_template_desc: Automatically syncs templates whenever files change inside your template scan directory. Edit a template folder and the template content updates automatically.
watcher_footer_desc: Watchers use debounced file system events. Changes are detected within a few seconds of the last file save. Disabling a watcher frees system resources.
corner_radius_desc: Controls every rounded corner in the app, cards, buttons, inputs, and dropdowns. 0 for sharp, square corners.
density_desc: Scales padding, margins, and spacing everywhere, lower for a tighter, compact layout.
text_size_desc: Scales all text (and anything sized relative to it) across the app.
scrollbar_desc: Hides the scrollbar across the entire app when toggled off. You can still scroll with keyboard, trackpad, or mouse wheel.
animation_intensity_desc: Controls how much motion the app plays. Full keeps all animations, Subtle shortens them, and None disables them entirely.
view_entrance_desc: The animation used when switching views and tabs.
custom_css_desc: Inject your own CSS to restyle anything in the app. Applies instantly on save. Use it for fine-grained tweaks the built-in settings can't express.
animation_threshold_desc: Project lists larger than this render without entrance/exit animations, keeping the view fast on weaker machines. Lower values animate fewer cards.
time_tracking_desc: Export your projects' open-time stats to a file you can keep anywhere. Restore it on a new computer or after a full app-data reset.
icon_opacity_desc: Controls the background icon opacity on project cards. Lower values make the icon more subtle, higher values make it more visible.
background_color_desc: Background color applies across all themes. In light mode the app derives card surfaces, borders, and overlays from your chosen background. In dark mode the background sets the base page color.
raised_contrast_desc: How far raised surfaces (cards, inputs, menus) sit from your background color. Higher values give more separation; 0 makes them identical to the background.
setup_wizard_desc: Reopens the first-time setup flow where you can reconfigure scan folders, categories, accent color, and corner radius. Settings already saved will be kept, you can always skip steps you don't need to change.
updates_desc: Check if a new version of GodotHub is available. Updates are downloaded and installed automatically, then applied on restart.
report_bug_desc: Help improve GodotHub by reporting issues on GitHub.
token_help_desc: Create a token at github.com/settings/tokens. You only need to check the public_repo scope if you want private repo access, otherwise leave all scopes unchecked. No sensitive permissions required.
new_ui_desc: Enables the experimental new interface. Some areas are still unstable and may be unresponsive.
new_ui_tooltip: Beta feature; this UI is unstable and may be unresponsive in some areas.
switch_to_classic_ui_desc: Leaves the experimental new interface and returns to the classic UI. You can switch back anytime from Settings → Appearance.
switch_to_classic_confirm_desc: The app will switch to the classic interface immediately. You can switch back to the new UI anytime from Settings.
switch_to_new_ui_confirm_desc: The app will switch to the experimental interface immediately. Some areas are still unstable; you can switch back anytime from Settings → Appearance.
card_layout_desc: Show the sidebar, views, and titlebar as separate floating rounded cards. Turn off for a connected layout where everything merges into one surface, like the classic UI.
use_os_decorations_desc: Use your operating system's native title bar and window controls instead of GodotHub's custom title bar. Requires a restart to take full effect.
